parameters.name: CronBeginDate
parameters.description: The start time of timed scheduling. The task flow is not scheduled before this point in time.

parameters.name: CronEndDate
parameters.description: The end time of timed scheduling. The task flow is not scheduled after this point in time.

parameters.name: CronStr
parameters.description: The cron expression for timed scheduling.

parameters.name: CronType
parameters.description:
The scheduling cycle type. Valid values:
- **HOUR**: hourly scheduling
- **DAY**: daily scheduling
- **WEEK**: weekly scheduling
- **MONTH**: monthly scheduling

parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The task flow ID, which is the unique identifier of the task flow.

parameters.name: ScheduleParam
parameters.description: The event scheduling configuration in JSON string format.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> Move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console to view the tenant ID. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).

parameters.name: TimeZoneId
parameters.description: The time zone setting. Default value: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8).

parameters.name: TriggerType
parameters.description:
The trigger type. Valid values:
- **Cron**: timed scheduling
- **Event**: event-triggered
